description: This file contains validation functions for UUIDs, URLs, file paths, filenames, and MIME types, including security checks against path traversal and MIME spoofing.

methods.name: isValidUUID
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid UUID v4.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid URL.

methods.name: isPathTraversal
methods.description: Checks if a string contains path traversal patterns.

methods.name: isUnsafeFilePath
methods.description: Checks if a file path is unsafe or contains traversal patterns.

methods.name: validateMimeTypeAndExtensionMatch
methods.description: Validates that the file extension matches the declared MIME type, preventing spoofing.
